column1: # SuperView Graphics (SGX/SVG), IFF-RGFX, YAFA, CDXL and Amiga bitmap fonts: RECOIL has none of them.

column4: RECOIL has no Amiga SGX support (it only knows the SymbOS SGX) and rejects the file. Layout per Kleinert's SGX spec v4.2 with the sample-measured offsets (data at 822, 8-bit chunky, 256-entry palette). Output matches testimg-lz77.sgx pixel for pixel, and that file's zlib payload inflates to exactly this file's data. Reviewed: clean photo of orange flowers.
Same picture as testimg.sgx stored as LZ77 (length plus zlib stream); the decoded pixels are identical to the raw file's. RECOIL rejects it. Reviewed: clean photo of orange flowers.

SVG Graphics File with the 8-bit chunky body packed by XPK NUKE; RECOIL rejects it. The unpacked bytes (Ancient 2.x, BSD-2, run as a black box) rendered through the header palette in Python give pixels identical to ours. Reviewed: the SuperView splash screen (red SUPERVIEW lettering, gold spheres on a blue gradient), clean.

SVG Graphics File with a 32-bit RGBA body packed by XPK RLEN; RECOIL rejects it. Reviewed: rainbow disc with a cartouche, checker corners transparent. Alpha is kept: rgb() is black where alpha is 0, and flattened over gray c0c0c0 the output equals the one reviewed before.

YAFA planar 80x64, 5 planes, delta flag. RECOIL has no YAFA support and rejects it. Layout per YAFA-doc.txt, but the first frame is delta coded against an empty bitmap although the document says the first two frames are plain (PROF ends it below the plain size and it starts with the 16-pointer table). The opcode and data lists parse exactly (each column's rows add up to the height). First frame only. Reviewed: red cones on a white axis in front of a cracked stone wall. Cross-check: b.yafa holds the same scene at 160x128 and its 2x2 box downscale differs from this frame by a mean of about 5/255 per channel.

CDXL first frame, HAM8, 8 planes, rows interleaved (info 0x81). RECOIL has no CDXL support and rejects it. Header layout read off the samples (MultimediaWiki field order, corrected as in cdxl.rs). Black box: `ffmpeg -i f -frames:v 1` (LGPL, run only). Pixels differ from ffmpeg's by at most 3 levels in the modified channel only: ffmpeg keeps the held pixel's low 2 bits in HAM8 (AGA hardware behavior, checked: 0 mismatches against a Python HAM8 with held low bits), while this crate expands the 6 data bits the way its ILBM HAM8 does (the RECOIL convention). Reviewed: a dark blue gradient, the start of a logo animation.

Amiga bitmap font descriptor (hunk file with a DiskFontHeader), monochrome font. RECOIL has no font support. Layout per the AmigaOS wiki (Graphics Library and Text); the 16-per-row code chart is this crate's own sheet layout. Black box: monobit 0.54 (MIT) loads the same file; for every glyph from tf_LoChar to tf_HiChar the ink bounding box (the glyph's pixels cropped to their extent) in our chart cell equals monobit's, 0 mismatches. Not viewed individually; the glyph comparison above is the evidence. Alpha is kept: rgb() is black where alpha is 0, and flattened over gray c0c0c0 the output equals the one reviewed before.
